//hosting: RECLAIM is a Next.js app with dynamic route handlers and a server-side engine, so it
cannot be deployed as a static export. `source` points at the app directory and lets
Firebase's web-frameworks integration build it and place the server on Cloud Functions.
That integration must be enabled once before the first deploy:
The corpus and the model artifact must exist at build time or the deployed app will
report itself degraded, so run `npm run bootstrap` first.
Deploying to a different Hosting site than the default one is what `target` selects;
